contributions.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED (2,177.09) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, which is also Schedule A's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $2,177.09' AND its printed 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule A pages) $2,177.09' — three printed statements of the same figure
contributions.detail: +0.20 DELTA, RETAINED VERBATIM, NOTHING NUDGED. The 11 Schedule A rows sum to 1000.00 + 96.80 + 48.25 + 48.25 + 19.12 + 50.00 + 500.00 + 100.00 + 36.11 + 36.11 + 242.25 = 2,176.89, against a printed subtotal / printed schedule total / cover Column A of 2,177.09 — the filer's own stated figure exceeds the sum of his own itemized lines by exactly 0.20. HOW IT WAS TRACED, and why no row is named: (a) this sheet has ONE Schedule A page and its 'Subtotal for this page' equals its 'Total Contributions Received', so the page-subtotal gate and the schedule gate are the same gate and there is no second sheet whose subtotal could have been mis-added; (b) all 11 amount cells were escalated INDIVIDUALLY to 1200 dpi tight crops (this filing is TYPED, not handwritten — every glyph is unambiguous at that resolution) and every one reproduced exactly what is recorded, so no misread cell can absorb the 0.20 and there is no digit to correct: 96.80 is not 97.00, 19.12 is not 19.32, 242.25 is not 242.45, neither 36.11 is 36.21; (c) a 500 dpi full-width crop of rows 12-16 AND of the white space above the 'Subtotal for this page' label renders a wholly empty grid, so trap F1.5 (a ledger continuing below the last printed rule) does NOT explain it and no twelfth row exists; (d) the §A1 first-entry control and the §B5 one-past control both passed, so the row index is not shifted and nothing at either end is missing; (e) CORRELATED-ERROR SCREEN: not-correlated-by-absence — Frost has exactly ONE filing in this corpus (index.csv), so there is no sibling report in which the same +0.20 could recur. The 0.20 is therefore the FILER'S OWN ARITHMETIC, a fact about the document, and the cover is internally consistent with it (763.15 + 2,177.09 = 2,940.24 = line 5; 2,940.24 - 1,602.14 = 1,338.10 = line 7, all as printed). Column B 'Year-to-Date Total' is BLANK on lines 1 and 2 of this cover, so no cumulative anchor exists and none was synthesized.

expenditures.anchor: Column A 'Total this Period' TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE (1,602.14) on the p2 SUMMARY PAGE, equal to Schedule B's own printed 'Subtotal for this page $1,602.14' and its printed 'Total Expenditures Received (Sum of subtotals from all Schedule B pages) $1,602.14'
expenditures.detail: The 8 Schedule B rows sum to 647.22 + 53.96 + 93.41 + 242.66 + 93.41 + 281.02 + 70.46 + 120.00 = 1,602.14 EXACTLY — equal to the printed page subtotal, the printed schedule total and the cover's promoted per-period Column A cell, and it is the same 1,602.14 the cover carries at line 6 'Total Expenditures Made (From Line 2 Column A)'. Column B YTD is blank on this cover and was never summed. Note that this side closing to the cent is what isolates the contribution side's +0.20 to the contribution side alone.

itemized.notes: ⚠ A SECOND 2016 BLANK EXISTS, AND IT IS NOT THE ONE THE OTHER 2016 FILINGS USE. This cover is titled 'FINANCIAL CAMPAIGN REPORT / FOR COUNTY CANDIDATES' — NO '& LOCAL SCHOOL BOARD' — citing 'Utah County Code 2-5-2 & Utah State Code 17-16-6.5' with NO 20A-11-13, carrying the OLD Utah County EAGLE SEAL (not the 'HEART of UTAH' mountain letterhead) and the words 'COUNTY CANDIDATE' set vertically down the left margin. That is the 'county-only' blank of addendum D2, alive in 2016 and citing the 2-5-2 code section of the undated 2010 blank (addendum C1: template vintage orders nothing in time — here it does not even order CYCLES, since Voeks 17bb61d5 filed the school-board-headed 2-5 blank in the SAME seat and cycle). Its inner sheets carry NO '2016 County Commission...' strapline, and its Schedule B footer reads 'Total Expenditures RECEIVED', the county's own mislabel. As on the other blank, THE 2016 SCHEDULE B REUSES SCHEDULE A'S COLUMN HEADINGS ('Name of Contributor', 'Mailing Address & Zip Code') and there is NO Purpose column on either schedule. 4 pages, foliated 1-4 of 4 counting the cover, all four located and classified by their own printed headings: p1 cover, p2 SUMMARY PAGE, p3 SCHEDULE A, p4 SCHEDULE B. THE FORM IS FILLED IN TYPE, not handwriting — the cover fields, both schedules and the summary page are all born-digital fill that was then printed and scanned; only the signature is in ink. That is why every escalation below is unambiguous and why the +0.20 contribution delta cannot be a reading error. PAGE-FACE NAME 'Bradley J Frost' (Office Seeking 'County Commission Seat C', party Republican, residence American Fork UT); index.csv names NO candidate for this row, so the page face supplies it. ⚠ TWO REPORT-TYPE BOXES CARRY MARKS: '30 Days after the Primary Election' has a hand ✔ and '30 Days after the General Election' has a heavier filled/scribbled mark; the amendment radio is set to 'No'. The filer's own inconsistency is transcribed, NOT adjudicated (CHUNK_BRIEF §5). The channel labels this filing 'Post-Primary'. ⚠ DATE OF REPORT IS 04/21/2017 — nearly a year after the 6/2016 primary — on every one of the four sheets, and all the itemized dates are 03-04/2016. The cycle is 2016; the report is simply filed very late. Not reclassified. PRIVACY: not a redacted file, and the filer typed NO street line anywhere — the 'Mailing Address & Zip Code' column holds only city, state and sometimes zip. Recorded as city/state for contributions, dropped entirely for expenditures. Three contribution rows (both 'Paypal Credit' lines and JJ's Viewbox) have that cell left WHOLLY EMPTY by the filer — a distinct fact from redaction, from a form with no city field, and from reproduction loss. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN run on both sides: dates are dates, names are names, the address column holds places and the amount column holds money on all 19 rows — no inversion. No nil marks, no ditto marks, no continuation lines, no voided rows, no banner lines; the §A1 and §B5 controls passed on both sheets, so none of the five row-index traps of addendum F1 occurs here.
